source: Order adapted from the Daily Turkish deck: each lemma of its ranked list (itself adapted from the 2018 Turkish list of FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave, CC BY-SA 4.0, built from the OpenSubtitles2018 corpus) was matched by meaning to its usual Turkmen equivalent, then edited by hand: film-dialogue words dropped or moved down, Turkish lemmas that share one Turkmen word merged, everyday Turkmen words added where their use would put them. Ranks are an editorial estimate, not a Turkmen corpus count. The ranked list is scripts/turkmen/tm-wordlist.tsv (CC BY-SA 4.0); method in turkmen/TM-PROJECT.md 7.8. Glosses, examples and notes are original.

ex.en: This book turned out to be interesting.
Look, there's the bus coming!

cards.note: Points to something farther off; for something close, *ine* (here it is).

ex.en: I'm ill, so I didn't come.
If you do good, good will come to you.

cards.note: k becomes g before a vowel: *ýagşylygy*.

ex.en: We moved into a new flat.

cards.note: k becomes g before a vowel: *ýygnagy*.

ex.en: The children are laughing and playing.

cards.note: t becomes d before a vowel and before *-ýär*: *öwredýär*, *öwredip*; it stays before a consonant: *öwretdi*.

ex.en: There was a quarrel between them.

ex.tk: Men bu barada hiç zat bilmeýärin.
ex.en: I don't know anything about this.

cards.note: Its vowel is short, so t stays before a vowel: *oty*. *Ot* (fire), with a long vowel, gives *ody*.

ex.en: We have lunch together at noon.

cards.note: Not *günorta* (south).

ex.en: I have a stomach ache.

ex.tk: Şäheriň merkezi bu ýerden uzak däl.

cards.note: k becomes g before a vowel: *köýnegi*.

ex.tk: Ýedi meniň iň gowy görýän sanym.

cards.note: k becomes g before a vowel: *çakylygy*.

en: please (go ahead, come in, help yourself)

en: a mark of respect (after a man's name)

cards.note: Of a man. He *öýlenýär* (gets married); a woman *durmuşa çykýar*.
